q: Dreams are for dreamers. Goals are for achievers.
Keep your eyes on the goal, and just keep taking the next step towards completing it.
Nothing is permanent in this wicked world - not even our troubles.
Stop being a prisoner of your past. Become the architect of your future.
There is nothing better than the encouragement of a good friend.
Not everything that weighs you down is yours to carry.
Your chances of success in any undertaking can always be measured by your belief in yourself.
Make your stand today. On this spot. On this day.
He is a wise man who does not grieve for the things which he has not, but rejoices for those which he has.
The key to immortality is first living a life worth remembering.
Nothing is easier than fault finding.
Art is to console those who are broken by life.
Nothing ever goes away until it has taught us what we need to know.
Determine never to be idle. No person will have occasion to complain of the want of time who never loses any.
When the root is strong, the fruit is sweet.
Words used to attract the dull of wit are not to be relied on.
The only limits in our life are those we impose on ourselves.
Wake up and smile! Wake up and be grateful!
Live in the sunshine, swim the sea, drink the wild air.
Wise men speak because they have something to say; Fools because they have to say something.
A wise man can learn more from a foolish question than a fool can learn from a wise answer.
It's good to learn from your mistakes. It's better to learn from other people's mistakes.
No one can confidently say that he will still be living tomorrow.
None are more hopelessly enslaved than those who falsely believe they are free.
Don't try to be young. Just open your mind. Stay interested in stuff.
I'd rather welcome change than cling to the past.
Experience is simply the name we give our mistakes.
He is richest who is content with the least, for content is the wealth of nature.
The swift wind of compromise is a lot more devastating than the sudden jolt of misfortune.
A hut full of laughter is richer than a palace full of sadness.
If you want to change how you see your problems, you have to change what you value and/or how you measure failure/success.
Every artist dips his brush in his own soul, and paints his own nature into his pictures.
I hear and I forget. I see and I remember. I do and I understand.
Whenever you do a thing, act as if all the world were watching.
Keep away from people who try to belittle your ambitions.
Your best life will not be found in comfort. It will be found in fighting for what you believe in.
Don't just sit there. Do something. The answers will follow.
Wit is educated insolence.
Public opinion is the worst of all opinions.
Always do what is right. It will gratify half of mankind and astound the other.
There is nothing like looking if you want to find something.
It is the power of thought that gives man power over nature.
One of the advantages of being disorganized is that one is always having surprising discoveries.
The only real mistake is the one from which we learn nothing.
Success is built sequentially. It's one thing at a time.
Where words fail, music speaks.
When one door closes another door opens.
Great leaders are almost always great simplifiers, who can cut through argument, debate and doubt, to offer a solution everybody can understand.
It always seems impossible until it's done.
If you do not push the boundaries, you will never know where they are.
